profiles.description: Provides independent data protection oversight for the carrier's privacy program, homing in the Privacy department and leading privacy work within the Data & AI value stream while supporting Risk, Compliance & Regulatory Management. Owns fulfillment oversight of data subject access and deletion requests and the monitoring and reporting of privacy control effectiveness, and signs off on breach responses in privacy incident management. Participates in data classification policy authoring, PII/PHI tagging across datasets, purpose-based access restrictions, and fairness/explainability evidence capture for model documentation. Serves as the regulator liaison and DPIA advisor, consistent with the GDPR Article 39 mandate of monitoring compliance, advising on impact assessments, and acting as point of contact for supervisory authorities and data subjects.

profiles.notes: Sources stress DPO independence (reports directly to senior management, cannot sit inside IT/HR); the statutory-officer nature supports Senior Leadership even though the title lacks VP/Head-of. Packet's Lead relation on the Data Ai value stream is broader than the advisory/oversight posture in sources.

profiles.description: Hands-on analyst responsible for profiling and monitoring data quality across the carrier's data estate, detecting and triaging quality issues, driving remediation, and reporting data quality results into the governance forum. Uses profiling to analyze data patterns, structure, and content to surface anomalies and inconsistencies, sets up ongoing monitoring against defined quality metrics, and performs root-cause analysis on defects before coordinating fixes with stewards and engineers. Operates as the execution arm of the data quality framework owned by the Data Quality Manager, translating governance standards into day-to-day quality checks and remediation work.

profiles.description: Owns the enterprise data quality and governance framework within the Data Governance department, leading the Data & AI value stream's standards, stewardship, catalog, quality, and retention capabilities. Drafts and recertifies enterprise data definition and naming standards, onboards stewards into governance tooling, triages stewardship and quality exceptions to owners, and defines data quality rules and acceptance thresholds with published scorecards to stakeholders. Also owns registration and completeness validation of the enterprise data catalog and audits retention compliance across the data estate. Matches the industry pattern of a data quality/governance manager who defines and enforces standards, establishes quality rules and metrics, and coordinates remediation through data stewards.

profiles.description: Leads the carrier's data science practice from the Architecture & Analytics department, owning use-case framing, methodology peer review, and the model lifecycle gates across the Data & AI and MLOps value streams. Frames analytical problems and success metrics, translates business problems into measurable prediction targets and model findings into business recommendations, and owns governance checkpoints — submitting documentation packages for approval, promoting model versions through registry stage transitions, and approving retrained challenger models for production. Also owns AI incident root-cause analysis and certifies business glossary and reference-data crosswalk entries feeding models. Mirrors carrier Lead Data Scientist roles that lead a team delivering ML/AI solutions with accountability for technical decisions, production stability, and responsible-AI governance.

profiles.description: Hands-on modeler in the Architecture & Analytics department who builds statistical and machine-learning models for distribution, financial-crime, and enterprise analytics use cases. Owns building and calibrating the lead scoring model, clustering-based customer segmentation, propensity model training and holdout validation, feature engineering from customer and policy history, and assembling and profiling analytical datasets; participates in calibrating transaction-monitoring and sanctions name-matching thresholds for compliance teams. Matches the O*NET Data Scientists occupation — cleaning and preparing raw data, testing and validating models against statistical performance metrics, and presenting findings to business stakeholders — before handing models to ML engineering for production.

profiles.description: Domain-embedded steward in the Data Governance department who maintains business data definitions, quality accountability, and lineage support across Business Operations, Sales & Distribution, Risk & Compliance, and Data & AI value streams. Participates across 76 tasks including drafting enterprise data definition and naming standards, codifying standards into machine-readable governance rules, remediating duplicate producer master records, locating and compiling personal data for privacy rights requests, and applying retention classes and executing approved destruction of records. Fits the DAMA-style stewardship pattern of a business-facing subject matter expert who bridges business users and IT, maintains glossaries and quality rules, and supports privacy and retention obligations in their domain.

profiles.description: Administers the carrier's policy, claims, and billing databases and the enterprise data platform from Infrastructure & Data Platforms, supporting Product Delivery and leading platform work in the Data & AI and Technology Engineering value streams. Owns encryption key configuration and rotation, role-based and row-level access controls, entitlement provisioning and revocation, access-log anomaly monitoring, geo-redundant backup and replication configuration, failover and recovery runbooks, warehouse compute scaling policies, MDM platform access administration, and defensible purge of expired records. Aligns with the O*NET Database Administrators occupation — specifying users and access levels, implementing security measures, backup/recovery, and performance and capacity management — plus modern cloud data-platform stewardship.

profiles.description: Analyst in Underwriting Operations & Governance who runs the day-to-day mechanics of the carrier's delegated authority book alongside underwriting support work. Owns bordereaux receipt, logging, data-quality validation, and query resolution with coverholders, collection of coverholder application packs for due diligence, submission completeness review of exposure and rating data, aggregation of in-force and pending coverage for anti-selection controls, and pulling loss and exposure history for renewals; participates in reconciling MGA bordereaux against booked premium and policy records. Mirrors market Delegated Authority Bordereaux Analyst roles that oversee bordereaux data quality and timely submission, resolve processing queries, and feed coverholder performance monitoring, since bordereaux are the carrier's primary oversight mechanism over MGAs and coverholders.

profiles.description: Owns delegated authority governance for the carrier, leading the Underwriting and Delegated Authority Management value streams from Operations & Governance. Owns coverholder and MGA due diligence end-to-end — assessing financial stability and operational capability, compiling approval recommendations, and obtaining onboarding approval — and designs the binder itself: underwriting authority limits and class/territory scope, bordereaux reporting templates and data standards, and monitoring controls with referral triggers. Runs quarterly coverholder performance reviews, checks reported risks against authority limits, authorizes binds within delegated limits, and re-underwrites binder terms at renewal. Matches the Lloyd's-market delegated authority model in which the carrier retains ultimate responsibility and must exercise due diligence, contractual precision in binding authority agreements, and ongoing audit and performance oversight of coverholders.

Matches the platform-engineer pattern of building the self-service foundation — pipelines, infrastructure-as-code, and tooling — that lets development and data science teams deliver reliably, combined with classic DevOps release-coordination duties.

profiles.description: Manages an assigned caseload of disability claims in the Medical Claims Management department, leading the Disability & Absence Management value stream. Evaluates medical evidence against occupational duties to determine ongoing benefit eligibility, calculates and authorizes benefit payments including offsets and partial disability adjustments, develops and executes return-to-work plans with claimants, employers, and treating providers, and schedules independent medical exams and functional capacity evaluations when clinical clarity is needed. Coordinates STD-to-LTD transitions and Social Security offset pursuit with advocacy vendors, and documents decisions in ERISA-compliant determination letters. Matches industry disability case manager roles that make eligibility determinations, manage ongoing STD/LTD claims by applying contractual provisions and legal guidelines, and refer to vocational rehabilitation, clinical, SIU, and Social Security resources.

profiles.description: First point of contact for new disability claims in the First Notice of Loss department, supporting the Disability & Absence Management value stream. Captures first notice of disability claims via phone, portal, and employer submissions; verifies coverage, eligibility, and elimination period at intake; collects employer statements, job descriptions, and attending physician statements to complete the claim packet; and obtains HIPAA-compliant medical authorizations while explaining the process to claimants. Triages and routes claims to the appropriate case manager by complexity and product, and flags concurrent FMLA, state leave, and workers compensation claims for coordination. Matches the industry intake-specialist pattern of gathering and verifying claim information, ensuring documentation completeness, and routing cases onward — an entry-to-mid-level claims operations role.
